title: 生物除磷程序
summary: 本課以厭氧釋磷、好氧吸磷與排泥閉合為主線，從總磷與溶解磷、厭氧選擇區、可利用碳與磷比例、厭氧釋磷觀察進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops closing anaerobic release, aerobic uptake and phosphorus wasting through ten connected units, beginning with total and dissolved phosphorus, anaerobic selection zone, available carbon-to-p balance, anaerobic release observation. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 總磷與溶解磷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Total and dissolved phosphorus: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 總磷與溶解磷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Total and dissolved phosphorus and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先分清顆粒磷與溶解磷，才能區分生物吸收不足及固體分離問題。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish particulate from dissolved P to separate poor uptake from separation problems.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.
steps.failure: 只量正磷酸鹽會漏算顆粒磷。診斷與介入：重測總磷與溶解磷，將固體分離和水相反應分開診斷。

steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for total and dissolved phosphorus. Compare digested total-P analysis with filtered samples. steps.failure: 無法閉合時先檢查採樣與旁流而非宣布磷消失。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
steps.failureEn: Check sampling/side streams before declaring missing phosphorus vanished. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「全廠磷閉合」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for whole-plant phosphorus closure. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 全廠磷閉合
knowledge.text: 無法閉合時先檢查採樣與旁流而非宣布磷消失。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
knowledge.textEn: Check sampling/side streams before declaring missing phosphorus vanished. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 0.5 kg/d。用「全廠磷閉合」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 0.5 kg/d. Explain the direction using whole-plant phosphorus closure, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 無法閉合時先檢查採樣與旁流而非宣布磷消失。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
磷可像氮一樣直接當作氣體消失。
optionsEn: Check sampling/side streams before declaring missing phosphorus vanished.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Phosphorus can simply vanish as gas like nitrogen.
quiz.explanation: 無法閉合時先檢查採樣與旁流而非宣布磷消失。 在離線工作台先選取「全廠磷閉合」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Check sampling/side streams before declaring missing phosphorus vanished. In the offline workbench, select the observation point for whole-plant phosphorus closure. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.
